post.summary: Registers a Student or Teacher account and creates the linked profile.
post.description: Public registration. Passwords are hashed; duplicate email or role-specific numbers are rejected.

requestBody.description: Registration details, including the role and corresponding student or employee number.

400.description: Invalid registration fields, role or missing role-specific identifier.

409.description: Email or role-specific identifier already exists.

post.summary: Authenticates an existing Student or Teacher using a password.
post.description: On success, the API issues its cookie-authentication ticket through SignInAsync.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing fields.

post.summary: Logs out the current user by clearing the API authentication cookie.
post.description:
Signs the user out of cookie authentication.
The response instructs the client to remove its authentication cookie.

200.description: The user has been signed out successfully.

get.summary: Retrieves the signed-in user and their Student or Teacher profile.
get.description: Requires API cookie authentication and uses the authenticated user identifier.

404.description: Matching Student or Teacher profile not found.

put.summary: Updates the signed-in Student or Teacher profile name.
put.description: Only the authenticated user's own first and last names are updated.

404.description: Matching Student or Teacher profile not found.

post.summary: Uploads or replaces the logged-in Student or Teacher profile picture.
post.description: The image is stored in Blob Storage and its URL is saved in SQL Server.

image.description: A JPG or PNG image, up to 5 MB.

get.description: Public endpoint for displaying categories in the MVC interface.

post.description: Teacher role required; duplicate category names are rejected.

put.description: Teacher role required; category names must remain unique.

409.description: Another category already has this name.

delete.description: Teacher role required; categories linked to courses cannot be deleted.

get.description:
Public endpoint. Visitors, Students and Teachers can
browse available courses without requiring authentication.

post.summary: Creates a course for the signed-in Teacher.
post.description: Teacher role required. The supplied category must exist and the course code must be unique.

requestBody.description: Course code, title, description and category identifier.

get.summary: Lists courses created by the signed-in Teacher.
get.description: Teacher role required; courses are filtered by the current Teacher profile.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific course by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the course to retrieve.

404.description: No course was found with the specified ID.

put.summary: Updates a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.
put.description: Rejects changes by a different Teacher, missing categories, and duplicate course codes.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

delete.summary: Deletes a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.
delete.description: Deletion is blocked when the course already has enrolments.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

post.summary: Uploads or replaces a course image.
post.description:
Only the Teacher who owns the course can upload its image.
The file is stored in Azure Blob Storage.
The image URL is saved in SQL Server.

image.description: The JPG or PNG image to upload.

403.description: Teacher does not own the course.

delete.summary: Removes an image from a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.

403.description: Teacher does not own the course.

get.summary: Checks whether an API caller is authenticated.
get.description: Diagnostic endpoint available to either authenticated role.

post.summary: Enrols the signed-in Student in a course.
post.description: Creates a Pending enrolment. Duplicate enrolments are rejected.

404.description: Student profile or course not found.

409.description: Student already enrolled in this course.

get.summary: Lists enrolments belonging to the signed-in Student.
Retrieves an enrolment owned by the signed-in Student.
get.description: Students may not read another Student's enrolment.

403.description: Not the owning Student or wrong role.

delete.summary: Withdraws the signed-in Student from their own course enrolment.
delete.description: An enrolment with a recorded result cannot be withdrawn.

403.description: Not the owning Student or wrong role.

get.summary: Lists students enrolled in a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.
get.description: Teacher role required and course ownership is checked.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

put.summary: Changes an enrolment status for a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.
put.description: Accepted statuses are Pending, Confirmed and Cancelled. Cannot cancel after results are recorded.

400.description: Invalid status or cancellation blocked after results.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

post.summary: Records a mark and outcome for an enrolment.
post.description: Teacher must own the course; enrolment must be Confirmed and have no existing result. Outcome is calculated from the mark.

400.description: Invalid mark or enrolment not confirmed.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

get.summary: Lists course results for the signed-in Student.
get.description: Only results linked to the current Student profile are returned.

get.summary: Lists results for a course owned by the signed-in Teacher.
get.description: Teacher role required and course ownership is checked.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

put.summary: Corrects a recorded result belonging to the signed-in Teacher's course.
put.description: Recalculates Pass or Fail based on the updated mark.

403.description: Not the owning Teacher or wrong role.

get.summary: Checks access to a Student-only API endpoint.
get.description: Diagnostic endpoint restricted to Student role.

get.summary: Checks access to a Teacher-only API endpoint.
get.description: Diagnostic endpoint restricted to Teacher role.
